confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Zanzibar (Stone Town and the beach areas) and East African coastal tourism pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are the most grounded; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by area and season, and July is high season. Cocktail and wine_glass were not directly known with confidence, so they are set from the local beer relationship (cocktail roughly 3.5 times beer, wine glass roughly 3.25 times beer). FX row: the RBA figure was taken from a search summary of the RBA statistics page plus a secondary site; the F11 table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to coastal East African tourist centres such as Mombasa and Dar es Salaam, adjusted upward for Zanzibar's tourism premium, with Stone Town mid-range restaurants and guesthouses as the reference venues. No web sources were used for the city-price anchors.
